newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: SM Prime rises 4.0 pct in midsession.
newsitem.headline: SM Prime rises 4.0 pct in midsession.

text.p: The share price of the Philippines' largest retail chain operator, SM Prime Holdings Inc rose 30 centavos, or four percent, to 7.80 pesos in mid-trade on Monday on foreign buying, traders said.

"The profile of the buyers is mostly foreign. There's renewed interest on the issue possibly because of expectations that second quarter earnings will be better," said Alexis Cabel, analyst at Angping & Associates Securities.
Cabel said that retail firms usually do better by the second quarter when the school year starts.
SM Prime was one of two gainers among the top ten most heavily traded issue. The stock market's main index shed 12.58 points to 2,796.87 in mid-trade.
